REAR PLANETARY GEAR INSPECTION
MEASURE PLANETARY PINION GEAR THRUST CLEARANCE
Using a feeler gauge, measure the planetary pinion gear thrust clearance.

0.20-0.60 mm (0.0079-0.0236 in.)
